title: Add A Test Connection Option For Uploading Data
symptom: User using Dexcom G6 wants to upload data to Dexcom Share but is unsure if settings are correct; waited and saw no activity, suspected wrong password, changed it, still no activity, but later data was sent and followed.
evidence_quote: I waited for a while and didn't see any activity. I checked my password and it seemed to be wrong. I changed it to a seemingly correct password. I waited for a while and didn't see any activity.
